meaning.en: Not sanctioned; not approved by a sanctioning body.

sentences.en: There are also sanctioned nude beaches and unsanctioned beaches, where you go buff at your own risk.

sentences.en: But today, unsanctioned tinkerers have more power than ever.

sentences.en: These cadets were an unsanctioned group who policed the Corps of Cadets who committed dishonorable acts.

sentences.en: Several leading filmmakers put the annual production of unsanctioned, independent films at fewer than 200.

sentences.en: It found that many of its workers had unsanctioned servers under their desks.

sentences.en: China's stability - obsessed government frowns on unsanctioned religious gatherings and regularly detains priests and seminarians.
